question: Which files are attached to this record, and who can see them?

steps.name: files
steps.soql: SELECT ContentDocument.Title, ContentDocument.FileExtension, ContentDocument.ContentSize, ShareType, Visibility, ContentDocument.LastModifiedDate FROM ContentDocumentLink WHERE LinkedEntityId = '{id}' ORDER BY ContentDocument.LastModifiedDate DESC

traps: Visibility AllUsers is needed for portal and community users to see a file.
